import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import os
import sqlite3
import time
from contextlib import closing
from pathlib import Path

from lexinform.adapters.sqlite_repo import SqliteBillRepository

source = Path(os.environ["DA_STATE_SQL"])
output = Path(os.environ["DA_PROFILE_OUTPUT"])
output.mkdir()
raw = source.read_bytes()
database = output / "restored.db"
repository = SqliteBillRepository(database)
repository.migrate()
start = time.perf_counter()
repository.restore(raw.decode())
restore_seconds = time.perf_counter() - start
with closing(sqlite3.connect(database)) as restored:
    assert restored.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone() == ("ok",)
    assert not restored.execute("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").fetchall()
    identities = restored.execute("SELECT term, number FROM bills ORDER BY term, number").fetchall()
    schema = {
        "tables": restored.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'").fetchone()[0],
        "indexes": restored.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index' AND sql IS NOT NULL").fetchone()[0],
        "version": restored.execute("PRAGMA user_version").fetchone()[0],
    }
    new_rows = {
        name: restored.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM {name}").fetchone()[0]
        for name in ("computation_results", "result_applications")
        if restored.execute("SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE name = ?", (name,)).fetchone()
    }
projections = []
for term, number in identities:
    bill = repository.get(term, number)
    assert bill is not None
    projections.append(bill.model_dump(mode="json"))
known_bill = repository.get(10, "2699")
assert known_bill is not None
memo = repository.load_analysis_memo()
start = time.perf_counter()
saved = repository.dump().encode()
dump_seconds = time.perf_counter() - start
repository.close()
(output / "roundtrip.sql").write_bytes(saved)
report = {
    "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), "source_bytes": len(raw),
    "sql_sha256": hashlib.sha256(saved).hexdigest(), "sql_bytes": len(saved),
    "gzip_bytes": len(gzip.compress(saved, mtime=0)), "sqlite_bytes": database.stat().st_size,
    "restore_seconds": restore_seconds, "dump_seconds": dump_seconds,
    "bills": len(projections), "analysis_records": sum(row["analysis"] is not None for row in projections),
    "projection_sha256": hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(projections, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),
    "memo_sha256": hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(memo, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),
    "memos": len(memo), "schema": schema, "new_rows": new_rows,
    "known_bill_2699": known_bill.status.value,
    "integrity": "ok", "foreign_key_errors": 0,
    "scope": "Isolated restore/read; no pipeline, provider or Telegram call; no legacy history backfill.",
}
(output / "profile.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(report))

import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import os
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from pathlib import Path

from lexinform.models import BillStatus, PublicationKind, TextDocument
from tests.fakes import FakeTextExtractor
from tests.harness import World


def test_computation_history_state_profile(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    output = Path(os.environ["DA_PROFILE_OUTPUT"])
    output.mkdir()
    report = {}

    def snapshot(world, identity):
        raw = world.repo.dump().encode()
        (output / f"{identity}.sql").write_bytes(raw)
        path = tmp_path / f"{identity}.db"
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(path)) as database, database:
            database.executescript(raw.decode())
            assert database.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone() == ("ok",)
            assert not database.execute("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").fetchall()
            history = {}
            for table in ("computation_results", "result_applications"):
                if database.execute("SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE name=?", (table,)).fetchone():
                    history[table] = database.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM {table}").fetchone()[0]
        bill = world.bill("3039")
        record = bill.analysis.model_dump(mode="json") if bill.analysis else None
        if record:
            record.pop("computation_id", None)
        row = {
            "sql_bytes": len(raw), "gzip_bytes": len(gzip.compress(raw, mtime=0)),
            "sqlite_bytes": path.stat().st_size, "sql_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
            "history": history, "status": bill.status.value, "record": record,
            "texts": world.publisher.texts(PublicationKind.NEW_BILL),
            "requests": [{"payload_sha256": req.payload_sha256, "custom_id": req.custom_id,
                "envelope_sha256": hashlib.sha256(req.model_dump_json().encode()).hexdigest(),
                "estimated_cost_usd": req.estimated_cost_usd} for req in world.batch.submitted],
        }
        report[identity] = row

    for scenario in ("fresh", "superseded"):
        world = World(profile="production", extractor=FakeTextExtractor(by_content={b"new": "Nowy tekst ustawy. " * 100}))
        world.add_bill("3039", "Projekt ustawy o cudzoziemcach")
        world.run(track=False)
        snapshot(world, f"{scenario}-pending")
        if scenario == "superseded":
            world.command("/skip 3039")
            world.run(track=False)
        world.batch.resolve()
        world.run(track=False)
        snapshot(world, f"{scenario}-collected")
        world.run(track=False)
        snapshot(world, f"{scenario}-cleaned")
        if scenario == "fresh":
            world.gateway.files["https://api.test/new.pdf"] = b"new"
            document = TextDocument(url="https://api.test/new.pdf", kind="print")
            assert world.analysis.reanalyze_bill(world.bill("3039"), document) is None
            world.analysis.submit_queued_batches()
            world.batch.resolve()
            world.analysis.collect_batches()
            updated = world.analysis.reanalyze_bill(world.bill("3039"), document)
            assert updated is not None and updated.revision == 2
            snapshot(world, "fresh-reanalysis")
        world.clock.advance(days=200)
        world.run(track=False)
        snapshot(world, f"{scenario}-expired")
        world.run(track=False)
        snapshot(world, f"{scenario}-repeat")
    (output / "measurements.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

import json
from pathlib import Path

from lexinform.adapters.sqlite_repo import SqliteBillRepository

root = Path('/Users/sobaleu/.codex/worktrees/scan-input-manifests/lexinform/out/corpus/j061')
reports = {}
for path in sorted((root / 'state-root').glob('*.sql')):
    repository = SqliteBillRepository(':memory:')
    repository.migrate()
    repository.restore(path.read_text())
    bill = repository.get(10, '3039')
    assert bill is not None
    for batch in repository.list_open_llm_batches():
        repository.list_llm_batch_items(batch.batch_id)
    for intent in repository.list_queued_batch_intents() + repository.list_submitting_batch_intents():
        intent.request.verify_payload()
    saved = repository.dump()
    repository.close()
    assert saved == path.read_text(), path.name
    reports[path.name] = {'status': bill.status.value, 'roundtrip': 'identical', 'schema': 49}
(root/'rollback.json').write_text(json.dumps(reports,indent=2)+'\n')
print({'snapshots':len(reports),'roundtrip':'identical','scope':'Previous reader only; no writes by the old application or schema downgrade.'})
